verdict.rationale: The evidence shows debugging and analysis tooling: the Inspector and Scene Inspector for runtime debugging and scene analysis, the Spector WebGL debugger, and a scene-optimization docs section. The author also reports an API rework to reduce GC pressure. None of this is shown to be a real profiler, and the data-oriented scaling half of the story (ECS, jobs, instancing) is not evidenced at all. Missing for 10: a dedicated profiler with frame/CPU/GPU timing, ECS, a job/worker system, mesh instancing or thin instances, and independent corroboration of scaling heavy scenes.
